scripts.dev:be: uv run --env-file .env.local python -m uvicorn apps.api.main:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir apps --reload-dir core --reload-dir modules
scripts.dev:worker: uv run --env-file .env.local python -m watchfiles --filter python "uv run --env-file .env.local python -m arq apps.worker.main.WorkerSettings" apps core modules
scripts.dev:chat: uv run --env-file .env.local python -m watchfiles --filter python "uv run --env-file .env.local python -m arq apps.worker.main.ChatWorkerSettings" apps core modules
scripts.dev:migrate: uv run --env-file .env.local python -m alembic upgrade head
